Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment primarily uses XL-MS (Chemical Cross-linking) and HDX-MS. While HDX-MS is mentioned, the PRIDE metadata and the bulk of the quantitative analysis focus on the BS3 cross-linking experiment. No specific PTM enrichment modifiers from the provided ontology list (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used; the cross-linking is a structural probe rather than a PTM enrichment.

scope: PPARγ LBD (10 μM) or PPARγ/RXRα heterodimer complex with or without PPARγ ligand (10-fold excess)/SRC1–2/NCOR1–3/SMRT-2 (all peptides were 5-fold excess to protein) were incubated with BS3 (50-fold molar excess) (Cat:21580) for 1hr.
10 μM of the apo protein was mixed with 1:10 molar excess of ligand and incubated for 2 hours at 4°C for complex formation before subjecting them to HDX analysis.
